cauldron_cook.text: Mind the cat on the counter. She thinks she runs this place, and she is right.
Glastonbury was almost an island once, when the Levels flooded. Folk called it the Isle of Avalon.
The Glastonbury Thorn flowers in winter, and a sprig goes to the King each Christmas. Quite a lot of pressure for a bush.

then.text: Another cup? You will float up the Tor. Go on, off with you.

else.text: Here, a cup of tea on the house. You look like you have climbed the Tor.
